correctness.rationale: All finite quivers including loops and multiarrows have an explicit path basis and multiplication equation (6). Fixing the zero set of left-factor diagonal entries gives a complete basis count of each right-annihilator kernel: free y variables for arrows from that set plus free vertex coordinates only where all incoming-from-set x coefficients vanish. The disjoint-head factorization proves (1) for every prime power and all characteristics; summing q to the kernel dimension proves (2). Height-two diagonal pair counting proves (3), and the star/path difference follows from an exact degree-bounded polynomial identity. Independent direct finite-field Gaussian elimination confirmed every spectrum coefficient for 37 examples comprising 26,595 elements. No finite check is used as proof of the infinite-dimensional family.

value.rationale: A complete ann-dimension spectrum for every radical-square-zero quiver algebra is a natural isomorphism invariant giving all annihilator-size multiplicities and the nullity degree in one object. The star/path pair has equal algebra dimension, semisimple quotient and radical dimensions but a strictly positive exact nullity-degree difference for every finite field; opposite stars have the same scalar nullity but different complete spectra. These supply motivated structural boundaries beyond mere counting and retain a nontrivial orientation-sensitive invariant. The statement does not claim an unnecessary general theorem beyond the natural full classification or any unproved graph reconstruction.
